task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text: The importer now handles the export format described in the README. A bad row is reported with the line it starts on and skipped, and the rest of the file still imports. I couldn't find any file content that makes it throw. All 14 tests pass (`dotnet run --project tests`): the 4
digest: Read 5 files (5 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 1 time; re-ran them after its last edit.
